chapter_seo_title: Keke Opens a World Gate and Meets a Cool Mirror Beast in the Soul Realm
chapter_meta_description: Keke's paw print unlocks a world gate in the Soul Realm, releasing terrified half-ancestors. Xiao Chen faces a deadly ancient city. A mirror-image white beast appears with cryptic guidance.
og_title: The Mirror Beast Emerges: Keke's Soul Realm Discovery
og_description: Keke accidentally opens a world gate, unleashing half-ancestors from a sealed domain. Meanwhile, Xiao Chen approaches a primordial city guarded by two lethal beams of light. A mysterious doppelganger white beast offers a path forward.
